entities.summary: Muhammad Shaybani Khan, a notable figure in the history of Uzbekistan, associated with Shaybanid and Uzbek Khanates (1500–1740). Preceded by Shaybanid Conquest and Bukharan Khanate. Their legacy influenced Khanate of Khiva and Kokand.
